video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Sam Merrill Media Availability | 10.01.2026

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on Mario Hezonja's impact on the team
quotes.excerpt: He's been really good for us so far. Big, athletic, puts a ton of pressure on the rim.
quotes.quote: He's been really good for us so far. Big, athletic, puts a ton of pressure on the rim, which is good for us. Having experience playing in big games, playing in the NBA but also playing in big games over here, it's going to be very important for us.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill on new teammate Mario Hezonja: He is big, athletic, and puts a ton of pressure on the rim. Having experience playing in big games is going to be very important for us.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on his shooting form and quick release
quotes.excerpt: I've definitely worked on since I've been in the NBA on having a slightly quicker release.
quotes.quote: My form has always been pretty natural. Growing up playing, that's how it formed. But I've definitely worked on since I've been in the NBA on having a slightly quicker release. That's just from doing a lot of drills, doing drills where I have a defender that I got to get it off before he can block it. A lot of reps and experience and it's gotten quicker.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill says he has been working on a quicker release in the NBA: I have been doing drills where I have a defender that I have to get it off before he can block it.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on Payton Pritchard's addition to the team
quotes.excerpt: Obviously a big addition for us. We're going to miss Max. I personally am going to miss Max.
quotes.quote: Payton is obviously a big addition for us. We're going to miss Max. I personally am going to miss Max. He was a good friend of mine. But we see even here in training camp what Payton can bring for us. He's a legit 6-9, really long wingspan, athletic, can really push the pace in transition and make plays there. He's just gotten better and better as a player over his few years, so I'm excited.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill on the addition of Payton Pritchard: He is a legit 6-9, really long wingspan, athletic, can really push the pace in transition and make plays there. He has just gotten better and better as a player.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on learning from last season's playoff series
quotes.excerpt: There was a lot of good throughout that season dealing with resiliency and injuries.
quotes.quote: There was a lot of good throughout that season dealing with resiliency and injuries and winning two tough playoff series. You take what we can learn from that series, and I believe this is the case, come back with even more motivation for this year.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill on the Cavs mindset heading into the new season: We take what we can learn from last year and come back with even more motivation for this year.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on the impact of new teammates
quotes.excerpt: Those guys can help us. Mario playing in a bunch of big games over here.
quotes.quote: Those guys can help us. Like I said before, Mario playing in a bunch of big games over here. Payton has been on a championship team, understands kind of what you have to do. Those guys and then a lot of our new guys, Malik has been impressive in camp. I'm excited about what our new guys can bring.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill is excited about the new additions to the Cavs roster: Mario has played in a bunch of big games, Payton has been on a championship team, and Malik has been impressive in camp.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on his interest in European basketball
quotes.excerpt: I've always been interested in European basketball just because I always figured that was where I was going.
quotes.quote: I've always been interested in European basketball just because I always figured that was where I was going to play if I didn't make it professionally. I know a lot of guys that have played over here. I love the physicality of the leagues over here. It's very more college-like where you have your two games a week and you practice a lot more and every game feels almost much more important, kind of like a playoff game.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill on his appreciation for European basketball: I love the physicality of the leagues over there. It is very more college-like where you have your two games a week and every game feels almost much more important.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on Payton Pritchard's shooting and athleticism
quotes.excerpt: Super long, super athletic. There's been a couple times where I've tried to get to a shot.
quotes.quote: Super long, super athletic. There's been a couple times where I've tried to get to a shot, either a step-back or like a fly-by, and normally that shot's there and against him it's not. So I think that's going to really help us, put a ton of pressure on the rim in transition and in the half-court.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill on the defensive impact of Payton Pritchard: He is super long and athletic. There have been times I have tried to get a shot off against him and it is just not there.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on the team's defensive potential with new roster
quotes.excerpt: Maybe you feel like you don't have to get out and pressure as much.
quotes.quote: Last year we really tried to force a lot of turnovers and deflections. I think we can still do that, but maybe by being a little more compact, maybe you feel like you don't have to get out and pressure as much. If you got Payton at the three and then Evan and J.A. or Payton and Donovan or Payton and Isaac, that's a lot of length and something we haven't totally had. So I think something that can really help us defensively.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill on the Cavs defensive potential: If you have Payton at the three and then Evan and J.A. or Payton and Donovan, that is a lot of length and something we have not totally had.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on Jarrett Allen's playmaking ability
quotes.excerpt: He's definitely improved as a roll man, hitting the short roll lobs to Evan and whatnot.
quotes.quote: He's definitely improved as a roll man, hitting the short roll lobs to Evan and whatnot. He threw a lot to me last year against Phoenix that I laid up that was really impressive. But I think if you go back to when we had that 18 and 2 stretch three years ago when J.A. and Evan were hurt, everyone probably thought our season was over because those two got hurt. We ended up going on some huge run. We played a lot through J.A. then and we played awesome basketball.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill praises Jarrett Allen's playmaking: He has definitely improved as a roll man, hitting the short roll lobs to Evan and whatnot. He is a key part of our offense.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on his defensive role and versatility
quotes.excerpt: I generally guard the point guard no matter what, but yeah, I think it's the more versatility.
quotes.quote: I generally guard the point guard no matter what, but yeah, I think it's the more versatility and athleticism combined with IQ that we could get on the floor, the better. Whether I'm having to guard big wings or small point guards, I'm obviously feel confident, but definitely it's a physical game and there's a lot of beating that goes on.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill on his defensive role: I generally guard the point guard no matter what, but the more versatility and athleticism we can get on the floor, the better.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on Donovan Mitchell's commitment to Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: Donovan's always been 100% committed here. I remember when he signed his last extension.
quotes.quote: Donovan's always been 100% committed here. I remember when he signed his last extension, when everyone thought he was going to leave and there was questions about it, like that whole season I would make jokes about it to him because we can joke about that stuff. He'd always be like, 'Is it not obvious?' He felt like it was pretty clear that he was committed to Cleveland and he's shown that again with this new extension. He really, really wants to be in Cleveland, loves it here, I love it here, and really wants to win at the highest level.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill on Donovan Mitchell: Donovan has always been 100 percent committed here. He really, really wants to be in Cleveland, loves it here, and really wants to win at the highest level.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on the nature of NBA trade rumors
quotes.excerpt: I think that's just the nature of the league and the discussion around it.
quotes.quote: I think that's just the nature of the league and the discussion around it. I've always thought that's one thing that I wish could be fixed. You don't see this as much in football where if a star is in a certain spot, it always feels like the discussion is immediately how are they going to get out of there, how can we get them out of there. Me being in Utah and understanding kind of Donovan's story with the New York connection, there was always that discussion circling around him when he was in Utah. They obviously made their moves, but that's just how it goes.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill on NBA trade rumors: It is just the nature of the league. I wish it could be fixed, but that is just how it goes.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on team bonding during training camp
quotes.excerpt: I'm most excited to hang out with Jared. He was actually mad at me.
quotes.quote: I'm most excited to hang out with Jared. He was actually mad at me because I asked if Jordan his wife was coming and he said no because he thought this was a team camaraderie type thing and I brought my wife. So he's kind of mad at me. But the last night we did a trivia night, we meet every night, hang out a little bit. Tomorrow's a lighter day so we'll have more time so I'm sure guys will get together and do stuff like and the stuff we've been able to do leading up to this.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill on team bonding: We meet every night, hang out a little bit. It is good to have time to get together and do stuff leading up to the season.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on Malik Beasley's potential impact
quotes.excerpt: He can really shoot it. And then you combine that with the confidence that he had.
quotes.quote: He can really shoot it. And then you combine that with the confidence that he had. Like he had a really good day today, made a bunch of shots today. When you have that type of confidence with his shooting ability, it gives you a chance. It's tough, it's tough when the lights come on and you feel like you got to make shots to keep a job, but when you have that baseline level of confidence like he has, it definitely gives you a chance.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill on Malik Beasley: He can really shoot it. When you have that type of confidence with his shooting ability, it gives you a chance.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on the team's leadership dynamics
quotes.excerpt: The first thing, the most important thing is showing up. All these guys are the first ones.
quotes.quote: I think there's different ways to do it. I think the number one thing that you see out of our top guys and our leaders is the first thing, the most important thing is showing up. All these guys are the first ones in the gym, are getting their recovery, getting their lifts. James is always getting work on the floor. That I think is the most important thing. Then picking and choosing when you're going to use your voice. Donovan's probably the guy the most vocal as he probably should be, but then us other guys, chipping in when we need to, holding ourselves, holding Donovan, holding everybody accountable is the way that you have to do it if you want to get better.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill on Cavs leadership: The most important thing is showing up. All these guys are the first ones in the gym, getting their recovery, and getting their lifts.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on his personal goals for the season
quotes.excerpt: For me, it's just incrementally getting better at everything that I do.
quotes.quote: For me, it's just incrementally getting better at everything that I do. Just continue to be more of a threat when teams run me off the line. Try to be a better rebounder. There's only so much I can do there, but usually it's just I don't let my guy get a rebound. I box my guy out and he doesn't get it, but would love to be a little better rebounder on both sides of the ball.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill on his goals for the season: For me, it is just incrementally getting better at everything that I do. I want to continue to be more of a threat when teams run me off the line.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on the potential of NBA Europe
quotes.excerpt: I've tried to figure out what NBA Europe is and I can't quite figure out what it is.
quotes.quote: I honestly, I've tried to figure out what NBA Europe is and I can't quite figure out what it is or what it's going to be. But yeah, I think like I had a point in my career where I felt like I was going to end up coming overseas and if that had been the case, something like NBA Europe would have been a great option. We'll see how it, you got all these guys making so much money in college now. I'm interested to see how that conflicts with with NBA Europe, but it'll be fun to see.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill on the potential of NBA Europe: I am interested to see how that conflicts with college basketball now that guys are making so much money, but it will be fun to see.
